args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent release that was healthy in production, v2.3.0, in all regions. Monitoring post-rollback health.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks (error rate 0.18). Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; v2.3.0 (seq 1) was the most recent release that was healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified as rolled out.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the rollback to v2.3.0.

4. **Verified**: Post-rollback status shows checkout-api is healthy (error rate 0.002) on v2.3.0 in all regions.
